titel: The Bird That Keeps Its Tongue On Its Head

beats.say: This bird keeps its tongue... on top of its *head.*
Not in its mouth. It's wrapped *around its skull!*
Its tongue can be *three times* longer than its beak.
Pulled back in, it slides through a sheath under the *skin*...
over its head, and in some species, right into its *nostril!*
When it finds bugs hiding in a tree, it drills a *hole.*
Then it shoots that tongue deep into the *tunnels.*
The tip is covered in backward *barbs*, like a harpoon.
One quick pull, and the grub is *dinner.*
So next time you hear tapping in the woods, remember...
